opening.argument: The presentation ties extraordinary income prospects to recruitment and expansion of a structured team. It tells participants, “They'll recruit approximately 10 people per month,” and explains that “Spillover happens when your sponsor or someone in the team above you places someone in the leg beneath you,” describing a sponsor-dependent hierarchy. It then links business growth to financial freedom, stating, “The more effort you are able to put into growing your business the quicker you will achieve financial freedom.” The promotional slide displays $330,000 per month over 24-36 months while asking about $15,000 per day, and the closing slide directs questions to a WhatsApp number and email address under Mirror Trading International branding. These features make the disclaimers secondary to the central solicitation to recruit, participate, and pursue tiered earnings.
